methods.name: initMeta
methods.desc:
Create the sender's social meta. `user` must be the sender (S-02; it stays in the ABI for
compatibility). The meta stores the VERIFIED wallet `principalOf(dao, wallet).wallet` (0 for a
plain account), which later routes creator tips (re-checked at read time by `tipWallet`).

methods.name: initMeta
methods.desc: LEGACY shim (pre-hint selector, deployed semantics: stores the registry wallet of the sender).

methods.name: setMetaWallet
methods.desc:
Rebind the sender's meta wallet to the verified hint (`principalOf(dao, wallet).wallet`; 0 unbinds).
Backfill for metas stored with 0 or a registry wallet. ARC-58 wallets reach it through the social
plugin's `setMetaWallet(wallet, rekeyBack)` (spec §6.2, §6.11).

methods.name: updateMeta
methods.desc: LEGACY shim (pre-payment selector, deployed semantics: setting a wall gate creates no wall box).

methods.name: checkTipMbrRequirements
methods.desc: Deployed tip route, decided on `creator` (legacy shims and the deployed plugins' quotes).

legacyListCutoff.desc:
Timestamp of the first post box created by this version. Posts created before it may still
have legacy 16-byte-keyed vote/reaction entries; posts created after it never do. Set lazily
(no initial value) so an upgraded app stamps it on its first post, and a fresh app has no
legacy posts at all.

akitaDAOEscrow.desc: the named DAO escrow this contract routes fees to (name + app)

version.desc: the current version of the contract

akitaDAO.desc: the app ID of the Akita DAO

posts.desc: All the posts on the network

votes.desc: Counters for each post to track votes

votelist.desc: Legacy user votes keyed by 16-byte prefixes. Read and deleted only; new votes go to `voteRecords`.

voteRecords.desc: User votes and their impact, keyed by sha256(user || ref)

reactions.desc: Counters for each post to track reactions

reactionlist.desc: Legacy reactions keyed by 16-byte prefixes. Read and deleted only; new reactions go to `reactionRecords`.

reactionRecords.desc: Who has reacted to what, keyed by sha256(user || ref || NFT)

meta.desc: The meta data for each user

refTypes.desc: Registered ref types (key = uint64 ID, value = name + external flag + schema)
